title: Odd Koschorke classes
summary: We introduce odd Koschorke classes in odd (K)-theory by using degeneracy loci of self-adjoint Fredholm operators. These classes are characteristic classes analogous to the even Koschorke classes in even (K)-theory. We study two aspects of these classes: their role as obstruction classes and their realization as characteristic classes with real coefficients for odd twisted (K)-theory.
